dct_creator_sm: Pawlowicz, Rich (University of British Columbia, University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2439-963X
dct_description_sm: Raw drifter data (L1 datasets) from two different expendable surface drifter programs have been merged and put into a uniform format (L2 dataset) which was then quality controlled, with classifications added for all locations dividing them in "valid", "bad", "partly grounded", and "mostly grounded". The final L3 dataset is provided here.
This dataset contains quality-controlled data from GPS-tracked expendable surface drifters in the Salish Sea, deployed over the years 2015-2018.
